source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-176–180 release-time controls were rechecked on 2026-08-24. Public wording remains non-prescriptive for surface disinfection, plant growth regulators, contamination classification, acclimation, and cryogenic preservation; current product labels, facility controls, and organism-specific procedures govern actual practice.
